_comment: Tier-2 for SPARTA: the four failures that produce a plausible answer instead of an error. DSMC's characteristic defect is silent, so these are the claims most worth defending by execution. (A) 'global nrho' and 'global fnum' both default to 1.0 in update.cpp, so omitting them yields a gas that never collides: Ncoll is 0 on every stats row while Np is 10000, rc=0, no ERROR and no WARNING. (B) mixture.cpp init_fraction errors only when fractions EXCEED 1.0 and then forces the cumulative array's last entry to 1.0, so fractions that under-sum dump the whole deficit on the LAST species: 0.25+0.25 is sampled as 25/75. (C) a react file whose product species are not all declared has every reaction dropped and the summary reads 'Gas reactions = 0'. (D) compute lambda/grid returns the literal sentinel BIG=1.0e20 for empty cells (compute_lambda_grid.cpp), which poisons any spatial average. STATISTICAL ASSERTION: only probe B has a stochastic observable. It is asserted with a BOUND, not a pinned value: 'last species takes more than 65% of the particles'. The broken deck was run at six seeds (12345, 777, 90210, 424242, 31337, 5150) giving last-species shares of 0.7480, 0.7500, 0.7370, 0.7570, 0.7430 and 0.7690 — range 0.737-0.769, sd about 0.012 — while the corrected deck gives about 0.503. The 0.65 threshold therefore sits roughly eight standard deviations from either side and the verdict cannot turn on the seed. A, C and D are exact comparisons (0 collisions, 0 reactions, the literal 1e+20), not tolerances. MISSING BINARY: with no SPARTA executable the fixture prints FIXTURE_ABORT and exits 1, and FIXTURE_ABORT is in forbid_in_output — a host without SPARTA records a FAILURE, never a pass. Verified with SPARTA_BINARY=/nonexistent: rc=1, sole output 'FIXTURE_ABORT=no_binary'. MUTATION CONTROL (executes): T2_MUTATE=1 replaces each of the four BROKEN decks with its corrected twin, removing the pathology while every assertion stays in place. Verified 2026-08-07 against SPARTA (24 Sep 2025) at ~/Schreibtisch/sparta/src/spa_serial: unmutated PASSES rc=0 with all_four_silent_failures_reproduce=True and a non-vacuous baseline (A_reference_run_collides=True at 690 Ncoll, B_reference_run_is_balanced=True at 0.5030, C_reference_run_has_chemistry=True at 2106 reactions, D_reference_run_has_no_sentinel=True at 2.50282e-05); with T2_MUTATE=1 it FAILS rc=1 and ALL FOUR keys flip independently — A_missing_nrho_fnum_is_silently_wrong, B_mixture_fraction_deficit_is_silently_wrong, C_undeclared_products_drop_all_chemistry_silently and D_empty_cells_return_the_sentinel_silently all go False. Re-verify: cd scripts/tier2_fixtures/sparta/dsmc_silent_wrong_answers && python source.py (rc=0), then T2_MUTATE=1 python source.py (rc=1), then SPARTA_BINARY=/nonexistent python source.py (rc=1).
